releaseNotes: Fresh new interface: the Elmashad ribbon is now the home of every Elmashad tool.
Tools open as centered windows over Excel: Dashboard, Settings, Updates, Logs and About.
Professional icons and a clean group layout in the ribbon.
The Updates button shows a badge whenever a new version is available.
Excel starts normally - nothing opens automatically anymore.
Light and Dark themes now apply instantly across every Elmashad window.
